items.title: Chinese large language models extend API usage lead to 30th straight week - Chinadaily.com.cn
items.summary: Roger Sheng, vice-president analyst for semiconductor and AI infrastructure at US market research co
items.content:
Roger Sheng, vice-president analyst for semiconductor and AI infrastructure at US market research company Gartner, said the strong showing of Chinese models on OpenRouter reflects their competitive edge in cost-effectiveness, but US developers are also making efforts to lower token costs while continuing to improve model quality.

"This puts greater pressure on Chinese developers to secure sufficient computing capacity to keep pace with advances in US models," Sheng said.

Three US-developed models ranked among the top nine — OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna, Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 and Nvidia's Nemotron 3 Ultra — with a combined weekly processing volume of 19.21 trillion tokens, up 29.53 percent week-on-week. [...] "The week-on-week fluctuations could reflect structural shifts, such as users switching between providers in response to pricing changes, new model releases or constraints on computing capacity," said Pan Helin, a member of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology's expert committee on information and communications economics.

Experts also cautioned that OpenRouter's rankings provide only a partial picture of the market, as they capture traffic passing through the platform but exclude usage routed through other intermediaries and do not represent the full volume of AI model calls globally.

"The figures should therefore be treated as a reference point rather than a comprehensive measure of market demand or competitiveness," Pan said. [...] Chinese-developed large language models continued to dominate Application Programming Interface usage on OpenRouter, an artificial intelligence model aggregation platform, with the weekly token processing volume surpassing that of their peers in the United States for the 30th consecutive week, according to the platform's latest data released on Monday.

items.title: Tencent unveils latest-generation large language model - FutureCIO
items.summary: Tencent has released Tencent Hy4, its latest-generation large language model, that will provide mode
items.content:
Tencent has released Tencent Hy4, its latest-generation large language model, that will provide model weights and system cards, underscoring its commitment to responsible open-source AI with a focus on cybersecurity and biological safety.

### Tencent Hy4

The new model introduces visual understanding capabilities and delivers major improvements in instruction following, long-context comprehension, and long-horizon agentic tasks. These enhancements provide stronger performance across diverse applications.

With advanced visual understanding, reasoning, and tool-calling capabilities, Hy4 now supports a wider range of tasks, such as fine-grained image processing, complex chart analysis, and mathematical visual reasoning. [...] ### Cybersecurity and biological safety

Tencent Hy4 is committed to advancing responsible open-source AI, incorporating safeguards throughout model training and release, with a strong emphasis on cybersecurity and biosafety to support safe, responsible AI use.

Cybersecurity: Hy4 is trained on defensive security data, prioritising proof-of-concept development and vulnerability remediation. The model includes reverse engineering and penetration testing for analysis, while explicitly excluding offensive exploitation materials from its training dataset.

Biological safety: Expert reviews show that Hy4 has strong foundational biological knowledge; however, its open-ended experimental design capabilities are more limited than those of frontier models. [...] Hy4 will be available on TencenHy4 will be available on Tencent Cloud TokenHub at a 50% discount off standard pricing through December 31, 2026.

items.summary:

Anthropic just released Claude Ship Claude Ship is a set of Anth
items.content:
Add as a preferredsource on Google

Anthropic just released Claude Ship Claude Ship is a set of Anthropic agents that takes GitHub pull requests from review to approval. It bundles 3 agents: Code Review, PR Steward and Claude Approvals. Your GitHub branch rules still decide what merges.

## TL;DR

- Size: 3 agents with a local `/ship` command.
- Runs on: Anthropic’s cloud for Code Review and PR Steward. `/ship` runs in the Claude Code CLI locally.
- Performance: Most Code Reviews finish in 6 to 10 minutes, about 3x faster than the research preview.
- Best: Claude Code team merged PRs more than doubled from June to September (self-reported).

## What is Claude Ship?

Per the Claude Ship docs, each agent owns 1 step: [...] | Feature | Claude Ship | GitHub Copilot code review | Cursor Bugbot | CodeRabbit |
------
| Reviews PRs | Yes, Quick, Standard or Deep per repo | Yes, Lite or Balanced effort | Yes, on every PR update by default | Yes |
| Pushes fixes | PR Steward commits to the PR branch (beta) | Hands fixes to Copilot cloud agent as a new PR (public preview) | Autofix via Cloud Agent, existing or new branch, 3 attempts per PR | “Fix comments” on all plans; CI fixer and merge conflict resolution on Team and up |
| Approval policy | `.claude/approvals.yml` sets seats per path; Claude can approve (beta) | Approving review if enabled (public preview) | Not described; CI check can gate unresolved findings | Not disclosed | [...] Per the Claude Ship docs, each agent owns 1 step:

- Code Review looks for logic errors, security vulnerabilities and broken edge cases. Findings land as inline comments, ranked by severity.
- PR Steward works on failing checks, merge conflicts and review comments. It pushes commits with its fixes.
- Claude Approvals checks each PR against an approval policy your team writes.

Code Review is generally available. The other 2 are in public beta.

## How does Claude Ship work on a pull request?

Code Review finds problems. PR Steward pushes fixes

items.title: New benchmark could help AI keep up with current events
items.summary: Advised by Ritter and Xu, Zheng was the lead author on a paper about the new benchmark. He will pres
items.content:
Advised by Ritter and Xu, Zheng was the lead author on a paper about the new benchmark. He will present their findings during the Atlanta-based satellite event of the 2026 Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS). The work is available on the arXiv preprint server.

###### Publication details

Jonathan Zheng et al., Parallel Universes for Temporal Evaluation and Knowledge Updating in LLMs, arXiv (2026). DOI: 10.48550/arxiv.2609.00184

Journal information: arXiv

Georgia Institute of Technology

Citation: New benchmark could help AI keep up with current events (2026, November 23) retrieved 23 November 2026 from [...] # New benchmark could help AI keep up with current events

##### Lisa Lock

Scientific Editor

##### Andrew Zinin

Chief Editor

New benchmark could help AI keep up with current events. DOI: 10.48550/arxiv.2609.00184")

arXiv(2026). DOI: 10.48550/arxiv.2609.00184

Artificial intelligence (AI) is struggling to keep up with the world. When queried about recent events, chatbots like ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude often rely on the same sources people have used for years to find information online.

"They basically become search engines," said Wei Xu, an associate professor in Georgia Tech's School of Interactive Computing (SIC). "But search engines are the old idea, and we don't want large language models (LLMs) to revert back to that." [...] To make frequent LLM updates more cost-effective, Xu, Ritter and Ph.D. student Jonathan Zheng have proposed a potential solution: feed the models data from the future.

"Creating an evaluation benchmark for current events is tricky because it can quickly become outdated," Xu said. "It's like shooting at a moving target. We create our own versions of future events, which gives it a fixed target."

Zheng calls it a parallel data universe of plausible events that models can accept as factual, allowing researchers to evaluate an LLM's ability to store new information before it forgets what it already knows

items.title: MemOnce LLM Memory: 1313× Smaller Cache at 1M Tokens | explainx.ai Blog
items.summary: MemOnce is a new open research architecture for long-horizon language models that tries to escape th
items.content:
MemOnce is a new open research architecture for long-horizon language models that tries to escape the linear GPU memory growth of classic KV caches without giving up the fine-grained recall people expect from full attention. arXiv 2611.27973, posted November 20, 2026 by Chang Nie, Chaoyou Fu, Songlin Liu, Yiqing Hu, and Caifeng Shan (Nanjing University and University of Science and Technology of China affiliations per arXiv and Hugging Face Papers), ships with a project page and GitHub repo Clare-Nie/MemOnce. The headline systems claim: at 1M tokens on adapted Qwen3.5-4B, ~1,313× smaller active memory state cache, 6.9× faster prefill, and +5.77% on their long-memory benchmark average—author-reported numbers you should treat as reproducibility targets, not vendor SLAs. [...] ## What we are watching next

- Independent replications on Hugging Face Spaces or GitHub issues with conflicting throughput numbers.
- Integration patches for PyTorch training loops beyond the authors' Qwen3.5 adaptation recipe.
- Downstream embeddings: the paper claims zero-shot representation tasks; if code or weights for those heads ship, compare against whichever embedding endpoint you already use in production RAG.

We will add an update if peer review, v2 arXiv, or major inference engine adoption appears.

## Related reading

Benchmarks and tables follow the MemOnce project page and arXiv 2611.27973 as of November 24, 2026. [...] ## How to try MemOnce this week

1. Read the paper — arXiv PDF for training objectives and ablations.
2. Clone the repo — github.com/Clare-Nie/MemOnce for configs; star count was modest on November 24 but the README and checkpoints are the gate that matters.
3. Reproduce one row — pick PersonaMem ~128K before chasing 1M; confirm GPU model, batch, and precision match the paper before quoting throughput externally.
4. Compare honestly — run the same prompt suite on dense KV with your existing inference server so savings are net of integration tax.

items.content:
中新经纬11月23日电 23日，燧原科技召开2026年第三季度业绩说明会。会上，燧原科技回应了过度依赖单一关联方、前三季度经营活动现金流为负等问题。

在业绩说明会上，有投资者提问称，面对腾讯“既是裁判员(大股东)又是运动员(大客户)”的特殊治理结构，独立董事团队如何确保董事会在审议关联交易、产能分配优先级时，不损害中小股东的利益？独董是否曾就“过度依赖单一关联方”向管理层提出过书面整改建议？

燧原科技独立董事黄雷对此表示，互联网大厂是国内AI算力的主要需求方之一，公司已与腾讯达成深度战略合作关系；同时，公司正积极推进与其他互联网厂商、大模型厂商、运营商以及头部行业客户的合作，以加强客户多元化布局。

黄雷提到，公司在《公司章程》《股东会议事规则》《董事会议事规则》《独立董事工作制度》《关联交易管理制度》等制度中对关联交易的审议、披露、回避等内容进行了规定，作为公司独立董事，依据相关法律法规，确保关联交易决策合法合规和公平公正，避免关联交易行为损害公司和全体股东特别是中小股东的利益。

值得一提的是，燧原科技董事、财务负责人唐伟在当天的业绩说明会上表示，公司预计未来一定时期内对腾讯销售占比较高的情形仍将持续。

谈及公司的前三季度经营活动现金流，唐伟表示，燧原科技2026年前三季度经营活动现金流为负，主要系公司尚处于亏损状态所致，同时，受当前半导体供应链紧张的影响，公司备货付款前置、收入回款后置。目前，公司已通过优化采购与备货节奏，强化客户回款管理等措施优化资金使用效率，截至三季度末，公司货币资金74.27亿元，资金较为充裕。 [...] 唐伟还介绍，燧原科技2026年前三季度营收保持较快增长，第三季度单季亏损同比收窄；随着营收规模扩大、规模效应释放，亏损有望持续收窄。在公司生产经营不受到不可抗力的重大影响的前提下，根据在手订单、产品交付节奏、员工成本预算、研发规划等因素考虑，公司预计在2027年可实现合并报表盈利。

燧原科技成立于2018年，专注于云端AI芯片的研发、设计和销售。2026年前三季度，燧原科技营业收入23.32亿元，同比增长331.74%；归母净利润亏损7.54亿元，较上年同期亏损8.88亿元收窄约1.34亿元；扣非净利润亏损7.62亿元，经营活动现金流净额-20.17亿元。第三季度单季，公司营收12.12亿元，同比增长395.34%，归母净利润亏损1.22亿元，单季亏损收窄。

11月23日，燧原科技收涨6.9%报360.59元/股，总市值1552亿元。

（文章来源：中新经纬）
